text: Twenty videos ago, Cinder Labs had an idea for a staking protocol. Here's the honest finish line.
EmberStake.sol is built, tested, and dress-rehearsed. Its own pre-mainnet audit caught and fixed a real reentrancy bug, and the indexer and API track every stake and claim.
Three real gaps remain, named plainly: no outside audit firm has reviewed it, there's no bug-bounty program, and the NFT marketplace and DAO ideas stay separate and unbuilt.
This is a finished build, not a perfect one -- and that's the whole point of telling it this way.
Series complete. Thank you for building EmberStake end to end with us.
